_comment: Variant B — balanced EMA, moderate RSI filter, standard ATR stop. This is the Layer 0 baseline.
rationale: The Layer 0 baseline. EMA 20/50 is one of the most widely referenced crossover setups. RSI 35-65 gives reasonable room for momentum without chasing overbought entries. Stop at -3% is a common starting point. All other variants are measured against this one as the benchmark.
